Ava (Docs): Heads-up — we've pushed a docs update that introduces a small but breaking change to the embeddings API examples. Please read and react :eyes:
Ravi (Eng): Thanks, what's breaking precisely?
Ava (Docs): In code samples and walkthroughs we renamed the request parameter from `model` to `embed_model` for embeddings endpoints to avoid confusion with multi-model routing. It's a docs + SDK examples change only, but it will affect any customer copy/pasting examples.
Jules (SDK): Noted. Is this just the docs or are we planning to change the public API surface too?
Ava (Docs): Docs-first change. The hosted API still accepts `model` for backward compatibility; however our recommended canonical param is `embed_model` and we'll start generating SDK samples using that. We want SDK owners to align samples and helpers in next patch release.
Sam (Product): Goal is to reduce ambiguity between text generation `model` and embeddings. Also helps instrumentation for routing. We coordinated with eng runtime earlier this week.
Ravi (Eng): Good. From infra side nothing breaking. We'll keep server-side aliasing so both params work for now. Plan is: accept both for 6 months, then issue a deprecation notice for `model` on embeddings in 6mo.
Jules (SDK): OK we'll update JS/Python/Go SDK examples and add a compatibility shim in the minor release. Can we get a canonical code snippet to copy from docs?
Ava (Docs): Yup — here's the canonical snippet to use in SDK docs:
```
# embeddings example
resp = client.embeddings.create(
  embed_model="r-instruct-embed-001",
  input="Short text to embed"
)
```
Replace previous `model` argument with `embed_model` in examples.
Ravi (Eng): Ops note: ops-bot will post a banner on the console for customers who use the example playground. We should include a short migration guide.
Ava (Docs): Draft migration blurb is in the doc page now (link shared in the docs site). Also added a short FAQ for customers on why the change.
Jules (SDK): Two quick asks for docs team: 1) add an explicit compat section showing both forms, 2) include why `embed_model` helps telemetry/routing (one paragraph).
Ava (Docs): Will do.
Sam (Product): Timeline: docs live now, SDK sample PRs requested this week, SDK minor releases next Tues/Wed, console banner by EOD Friday, deprecation timeline messaging to customers in 6 months.
Ravi (Eng): I'll file the internal deprecation ticket and link it here.
Ava (Docs): FYI added `docs-bot` notice on the page: "Embedding param rename — examples now use `embed_model`. `model` will be supported for 6 months."
docs-bot: [automated] page updated: /docs/api/embeddings (revision 2026-03-23T14:10Z) :bookmark_tabs:
Jules (SDK): I'll coordinate a compatibility shim and tests. Will ping when PRs are ready.
Ava (Docs): Thanks all — please :thumbsup: the thread when your area is done so we can close the rollout checklist.
ops-bot: [automated] console banner scheduled: 2026-03-25 09:00 UTC
Sam (Product): Quick comms note — include a one-liner for account managers so they can answer customer questions about whether their apps will break. Suggested: "No runtime break — examples changed to clarify routing. We'll support both params for 6 months and provide migration help"
Ravi (Eng): Added to the deprecation ticket.
Jules (SDK): First PR for js-sdk sample update created: https://github.com/redwood-inference/js-sdk/pull/1823 - link to follow when CI passes.
Ava (Docs): Awesome. Closing loop once all :thumbsup: are in.
Sam (Product): :rocket:
